summary: End-to-end verification of 'Retiros En Vivo' feature. Backend admin endpoints (/api/admin/live-withdrawals-sim GET + toggle POST) verified via curl with admin bearer token: GET returns {enabled:true, updated_by, generated_total:2}; toggle flips enabled correctly; no-auth returns 403; non-admin user returns 403. Frontend Playwright covered: (1) normal user (manclic@yahoo.es) sees rw-live-indicator with data-paused=false and 'En vivo · 15s'; expanding a card switches to data-paused=true 'En pausa'; collapsing restores to 'En vivo'; rw-sim-toggle NOT visible for normal user. (2) Dashboard recent-withdrawals-module loads content correctly. (3) Admin (admi@paylionsbit.es) sees rw-sim-toggle button starting 'Actividad auto: ON', toggles to OFF, back to ON (left ON as required). (4) Animated entrance: force-tick generated TRX-2026-DE0B48 (Cristina Molina García, 29510 EUR, Spain) → within 12s the new row appeared at POSITION 0 (top) of list with data-new=true and rw-new-badge-* visible; after ~14s the badge auto-expired (data-new=false, badge removed). (5) Regression: expanded card shows all 4 stage labels (Solicitado/En revisión/Procesado/Completado). All 5 flows PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Login page shows a full-screen 'Nueva administración PayLionsbit' modal (data-testid=new-admin-modal-overlay) that intercepts pointer events; automated tests must dismiss via 'Entendido' button before login. Not a bug, but consider dismissing modal on /login route only after auth or providing a stable close mechanism to avoid future test flakiness.
